results.title: Clean independent benchmark edge for microscopy segmentation model
recommendedActions: Publish benchmark graph edge and recommendation with normal provenance metadata.

results.title: Benchmark reused in model pretraining and public recommendation

findings.message: The model graph links training or pretraining data directly to the claimed benchmark.
findings.remediation: Suppress clean-benchmark claims and mark the evaluation as contaminated until an independent holdout is supplied.

findings.message: Training and evaluation split hashes overlap.
findings.remediation: Hold the benchmark edge, regenerate split manifests, and require a locked evaluation set before publication.

findings.message: Training labels and benchmark labels share a source that can leak answers into evaluation.
findings.remediation: Block recommendation paths that cite this benchmark as independent evidence until label provenance is separated.

findings.message: The benchmark was released before the model training cutoff, increasing contamination risk.
findings.remediation: Require explicit exclusion evidence or downgrade the graph edge confidence.

findings.message: The packet lacks complete independent holdout evidence for the benchmark claim.
findings.remediation: Attach split checksums and locked evaluation-set evidence before publishing entity-page or recommendation claims.

findings.message: Entity-page or recommendation publication is enabled while contamination risk is unresolved.
findings.remediation: Freeze graph recommendation paths and entity-page benchmark badges until contamination review is resolved.

recommendedActions: Freeze model recommendation paths and entity-page benchmark badges.
Attach contamination findings to the graph curation queue.
Downgrade or suppress benchmark-confidence badges until evidence is resolved.
Generate a reviewer packet with split, label-source, and edge-provenance evidence.
